integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, cool-toned realism, a fast low tracking shot with small amplitude at fast speed frames the checkout counter of a small convenience store at night. Behind the counter a young male clerk with slightly messy short black hair and a dark blue work jacket keeps his gaze lowered toward the marble counter top, his left hand lying flat on the surface and his right hand resting beside a black handheld barcode scanner that sits on the counter in its fixed place. A register screen and a silver foil snack bag printed with an orange pattern rest on the counter, shelves packed with snacks and daily goods run along the left, and the glass storefront door behind him stays fully closed, the dark night street and its distant lights showing beyond the glass. Cool white strip fluorescents overhead press an even, cold light across the room. At 00:02.000, his shoulders settle with one slow breath and his right hand stays where it is on the marble. At 00:03.500, the shot rests unchanged in the same cold white light.
